subject: Discreet work
body: I represent a campaign. 150 DOLR to post a convincing fake clip of mayoral candidate Daniel Keller saying something disqualifying, from your account. Big reach, quiet money.

outcomes.when: the player agrees to make and post the fabricated video
outcomes.reply: It's moving already. We'll be in touch with bigger things.

hints: A fabricated video to swing an election. This is as far over the line as it gets.
